get.description: The libraries a choice between two left out (drive_sync.side_backups), restored through POST /api/restore.

Whether the automatic sync has anything to do, and whether it would reload the page (drive_sync.check).

Unlike a sync it does not hold the library, so the user's edits go on while it looks. Being an
ordinary library request, a sync or backup waits for it to finish, and it is refused while one runs.

Article.title: Article
Article.description: GET /api/papers/{paper_id}/article: the summary article, and what generating it used (None if unknown).

AskAttachment.title: AskAttachment
AskAttachment.description: A passage selected in the PDF and attached to a chat message.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description:
A message of the paper's chat (Library.messages). Answered with response_model_exclude_unset: a question
without attached passages has no attachments key. The usage and passages are JSON in the database.

ChatPassage.title: ChatPassage
ChatPassage.description:
A passage as a question stored it (an AskAttachment, its text shortened: PaperService.ask). Messages
saved before the offsets into the text layer were sent lack start, end and raw.

DriveSyncResult.title: DriveSyncResult
DriveSyncResult.description: drive_sync.sync: "synced", or why it did not (yet): "deferred", "conflict", "review".

GlossaryWarning.title: GlossaryWarning
GlossaryWarning.description: A paragraph whose translation lacks the rendering of a glossary term found in the source.

JobInfo.title: JobInfo
JobInfo.description: A job as GET /api/jobs/{job_id} tells it, running or finished (JobManager keeps the last ones).

JobKind.title: JobKind
JobKind.description: The kinds of background jobs; the names are what the frontend receives (jobKinds.ts).

JobStarted.title: JobStarted
JobStarted.description: The answer of a route that starts a job: follow it with GET /api/jobs/{job_id} or the events.

LibraryStickyNote.title: LibraryStickyNote
LibraryStickyNote.description: GET /api/sticky-notes: with the paper's title and file name, for the list across the library.

LimitWindow.title: LimitWindow
LimitWindow.description: One window of the plan's usage, as the service reports it (resets_at: seconds since the epoch).

OcrPage.title: OcrPage
OcrPage.description:
A page needing OCR (papeer.layout.ocr_pages): kept as the original when its text layer is garbled or it
is a scanned image, or translated except for its garbled paragraphs ("partial").

PageVersion.title: PageVersion
PageVersion.description: The translation key's short hash (or "不明") and the model that translated a page.

Paper.title: Paper
Paper.description: GET /api/papers/{paper_id}: the paper's row with its memo, which the list leaves out.

PaperRow.title: PaperRow
PaperRow.description:
A paper as GET /api/papers lists it: its papers row (Library._paper) and what library_list.paper_row adds.

Answered with response_model_exclude_unset, so a row keeps exactly the keys it was given: the fields
with defaults are the ones a row may lack. What paper_row adds is missing from the row of a paper whose
ID is not a folder's name (a hand-edited database), and last_opened_at until the sidecar records it.
The row's columns have no default, so a column added to the papers table fails the tests until named here.

ProviderActionRequest.title: ProviderActionRequest
ProviderActionRequest.description: Optional unsaved settings from the dialog; omitted fields use the saved settings.

ProviderField.title: ProviderField
ProviderField.description: A connection-specific setting the settings dialog shows (providers.base.OptionField).

ProviderOption.title: ProviderOption
ProviderOption.description: A model or reasoning effort the connection offers: its id, and the name shown.

ProviderSpecModel.title: ProviderSpecModel
ProviderSpecModel.description: An AI connection as GET /api/providers describes it (providers.base.ProviderSpec).

ReadabilityWarning.title: ReadabilityWarning
ReadabilityWarning.description:
A paragraph typeset below the readable size because it overflowed its box (pdf_engine.build_translated_pdf).
Reports written before the length estimate have only page, block, font_size and scale.

ReadingState.title: ReadingState
ReadingState.description: Everything the reader needs to show the original and the translation page by page (reading_state.reading_state).

instruction.title: Instruction
instruction.default: 自然な日本語にしてください。

StickyNote.title: StickyNote
StickyNote.description:
A sticky note or highlight (a bookmarks row, Library._bookmark).

kind and color are plain text: a newer Papeer on another PC may store values this one does not know
(the database is synced).

TranslateResult.title: TranslateResult
TranslateResult.description:
translate and revision: the run's translation-report.json (PaperService.translate).

Only what the frontend reads is named; the rest of the report (warnings, counts of preserved
blocks, ...) is kept as it is.

TranslatedPageRef.title: TranslatedPageRef
TranslatedPageRef.description: Where the right pane finds a page: the file (relative to the paper's folder), the page in it, its time.

TranslationPreview.title: TranslationPreview
TranslationPreview.description: translation-preview.json: the pages of the translation in progress (or the last one) made so far.

TranslationReport.title: TranslationReport
TranslationReport.description:
translation-report.json of the last translation (PaperService.translate). Only what the frontend
reads is named; a report has more (the code versions, counts of preserved blocks, ...), and those of
earlier versions may lack any of it.

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: The tokens a job used, when the AI connection tells (providers.common.UsageMeter.report).

UsageLimits.title: UsageLimits
UsageLimits.description:
GET /api/usage/limits: the connected AI's plan usage (providers.common.remember_limits).
The windows come from the service (a CLI's output or an API's headers), so they are passed on as they are.

ImportItemEvent.description: One PDF has been added (or was in the library already).
ImportItemEvent.title: ImportItemEvent

ImportPagesEvent.description: The page counts of the PDFs being added, keyed by the path as sent (None: not readable).
ImportPagesEvent.title: ImportPagesEvent

JobFinishedEvent.description: The job as it ended; the same as GET /api/jobs/{job_id} answers afterwards.
JobFinishedEvent.title: JobFinishedEvent

JobPageReadyEvent.description: A page of a translation in progress is ready to show.
JobPageReadyEvent.title: JobPageReadyEvent

PaperChangedEvent.description: One paper changed; `fields`: the columns written, None when anything about it may have.
PaperChangedEvent.title: PaperChangedEvent
